answer: Identities funded from a common source within 5 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. Because the quartz graph is rebuilt each epoch, the nebula merge is applied at settlement and the pulse audit lists every linked key. A farm paying its aliases from one wallet hence collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. That is 9 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
